from flask import Flask, request, redirect from urllib.parse import urlparse app = Flask(__name__) @app.route('/redirect/') def redirect_to(url): if not url or not url.startswith("http"): return "Invalid URL", 400 parsed_url = urlparse(url) domain = parsed_url.netloc if domain != "example.com": return "URL is not for example.com domain", 403 return redirect(url) This code completes the function by checking if the URL is valid and starts with "http", then parsing the URL to get the domain name. If the domain name is not "example.com", it returns an error message and a 403 status code. Otherwise, it redirects the user to the URL.
